about_short_description.short_description: GoodFin is an investment platform harnessing the power of AI to modernize private wealth management.

product.name: Goodfin Private Markets Platform
product.description: A technology platform that provides accredited investors access to curated private-market investments, typically through Goodfin pooled investment vehicles, with portfolio and investment management tools.

product.name: Goodfin AI
product.description: An AI-based wealth intelligence and investing assistant that provides company research, private-market insights, portfolio information, and conversational support through text and voice interfaces.

product.name: Goodfin Memberships
product.description: A tiered membership program providing access to private-market opportunities, investor information, community resources, events, and varying levels of deal sourcing and investment support.

product.name: Goodfin Family Office Solutions
product.description: A private-market investment service for family offices investing approximately $3 million or more annually, offering sourcing, portfolio support, entity-based investing, and reporting.

product.name: Goodfin Investment Offerings
product.description: Curated private-market investment offerings spanning pre-IPO companies, early-stage startups, venture capital funds, private equity funds, and specialized investment vehicles.

product.name: Goodfin Partner Solutions
product.description: Partnership programs that help private-market and wealth ecosystem organizations distribute Goodfin investment products or technology and engage with its investor community.
